response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color, 'NO_COLOR') as color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) as invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'NO_COLOR')), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(invoiced_amount) as total FROM color_totals), avg_per_color AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) as avg_amount FROM color_totals), color_with_metrics AS (SELECT ct.color, ct.invoiced_amount, ct.invoiced_amount / gt.total as share, apc.avg_amount FROM color_totals ct CROSS JOIN grand_total gt CROSS JOIN avg_per_color apc), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM color_with_metrics WHERE invoiced_amount > avg_amount) SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) as avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(invoiced_amount - avg_amount) as avg_above_average FROM above_average
